<translated_code>
import sys

MOD = 10**9 + 7

def power(b, e):
    return pow(b, e, MOD)

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    # p is 6x6, initialize to 0
    p = [[0]*6 for _ in range(6)]
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            per = int(next(it))
            p[i][j] = per * power(100, MOD-2) % MOD
    # fill diagonal for missing rows/cols
    for i in range(n, 6):
        p[i][i] = 1

    # com: all 6-bit numbers with exactly 3 bits set
    com = []
    for i in range(64):
        if bin(i).count('1') == 3:
            com.append(i)

    size_f = 1 << 20
    f = [0] * size_f
    g = [0] * size_f

    # first part: columns 0,1,2
    for i in range(1 << 18):
        b = [[False]*3 for _ in range(6)]
        tmp = 0
        pos = 1
        for j in range(6):
            for k in range(3):
                if i & (1 << tmp):
                    b[j][k] = True
                    pos = pos * p[j][k] % MOD
                else:
                    pos = pos * (1 - p[j][k] + MOD) % MOD
                tmp += 1
        mask = 0
        for idx, comb in enumerate(com):
            # get the three players
            players = []
            for k in range(6):
                if comb & (1 << k):
                    players.append(k)
            p1, p2, p3 = players
            # check all 6 permutations
            if (b[p1][0] and b[p2][1] and b[p3][2]) or \
               (b[p1][0] and b[p2][2] and b[p3][1]) or \
               (b[p1][1] and b[p2][0] and b[p3][2]) or \
               (b[p1][1] and b[p2][2] and b[p3][0]) or \
               (b[p1][2] and b[p2][0] and b[p3][1]) or \
               (b[p1][2] and b[p2][1] and b[p3][0]):
                mask |= (1 << idx)
        f[mask] = (f[mask] + pos) % MOD

    # second part: columns 3,4,5
    for i in range(1 << 18):
        b = [[False]*3 for _ in range(6)]
        tmp = 0
        pos = 1
        for j in range(6):
            for k in range(3, 6):
                if i & (1 << tmp):
                    b[j][k-3] = True
                    pos = pos * p[j][k] % MOD
                else:
                    pos = pos * (1 - p[j][k] + MOD) % MOD
                tmp += 1
        mask = 0
        for idx, comb in enumerate(com):
            # complement: players not in comb
            s = comb ^ 63
            players = []
            for k in range(6):
                if s & (1 << k):
                    players.append(k)
            p1, p2, p3 = players
            if (b[p1][0] and b[p2][1] and b[p3][2]) or \
               (b[p1][0] and b[p2][2] and b[p3][1]) or \
               (b[p1][1] and b[p2][0] and b[p3][2]) or \
               (b[p1][1] and b[p2][2] and b[p3][0]) or \
               (b[p1][2] and b[p2][0] and b[p3][1]) or \
               (b[p1][2] and b[p2][1] and b[p3][0]):
                mask |= (1 << idx)
        g[mask] = (g[mask] + pos) % MOD

    # SOS DP over g
    for i in range(20):
        for j in range(size_f - 1, -1, -1):
            if j & (1 << i):
                g[j] = (g[j] + g[j ^ (1 << i)]) % MOD

    full_mask = (1 << 20) - 1
    ans = 0
    for i in range(size_f):
        ans = (ans + f[i] * g[full_mask ^ i]) % MOD
    print((1 - ans + MOD) % MOD)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
